text:
incident-bot: Incident #18421 (high-latency inference) resolved at 15:12 UTC. Timeline and logs archived at https://redwood/ops/incidents/18421. Creating thread for PIR scheduling.

chen: Thanks team — now that this is resolved, we should schedule the post-incident review. Preferably next week so we can assign a facilitator and lock attendees. I can host but would like someone else to chair. Availability? :calendar:

alex: I can do Tue/Wed morning (PST). Happy to be backup facilitator if needed.

maria: I can take facilitator if nobody else wants it. I'm free Wed 10–11am and Thu 2–4pm. Willing to prep RCA notes.

sam: I can chair Wed 10am (PST). I'll take the runbook and timeline section. @maria can you own action-item tracking?

lina: Wed 10am works for me too. Suggest we invite infra, runtime, and support leads. Also need product presence to confirm customer impact.

chen: Great — so provisional: Wed 10am PST, facilitator: @sam, scribe: @maria. @oncall-bot can you post current on-call handoff summary into the thread?

oncall-bot: Handoff summary: On-call was @alex -> @chen. Pager routes: infra-team then runtime-team. Key mitigation steps: 1) scaled up dedicated pool, 2) rollback of recent kernel patch, 3) temporary traffic reroute to fallback model. Logs and metrics link: https://redwood/metrics/incidents/18421

alex: Adding a short customer-impact blurb for the meeting: "~12 customers saw 20–40% increased latency for ~18 minutes. No data loss. Largest affected: partner-api-prod (p95 latency spiked from 120ms to 900ms)."

maria: Thanks @alex. I'll assemble a 3-slide pre-read: timeline, customer impact (quote + list), and initial action-item list. Will drop in the thread by EOD Monday.

sam: Can someone add the calendar invite and include the Zoom link? Also please assign preliminary action owners where obvious so we can reduce meeting time.

chen: I'll create the calendar invite and mark it as "Post-incident review: Incident 18421". @maria please post pre-read as a thread reply and I'll pin it to the channel.

maria: Will do. Proposed attendee list: @alex, @chen, @sam, @lina, infra lead (raj), runtime lead (olivia), support lead (tess), product PM (diego). Anyone else to add?

lina: Add security (mia) just in case of regression in kernel patch area.

sam: Sounds good. One ask: let's keep the meeting strictly 45min and focus on timeline, impact, and actions. I'll bring a suggested mitigation playbook update.

chen: Awesome — confirmed. Wed 10am PST, facilitator @sam, scribe @maria. If anyone can't make it, please state here and we'll record. Closing this scheduling thread; reminders will be posted 24h before. :white_check_mark:
